name: GymVibe 9-Minute KB AMRAP — Ballistic Row / Thruster / Reverse Lunge + Knee Drive
description: A brutal single-bell AMRAP complex from @gymvibe_: ballistic row, thruster (the source calls it a 'goblet cluster'), and reverse lunge + knee drive, run back-to-back with no rest for as many rounds as possible in 9 minutes. A strength/conditioning workout-set, NOT a flow. The source runs it at one weight (24kg/53lb); here it's a 30 → 40 → 50lb load ladder over the three thirds so you build into the top weight instead of opening on your max.

flowSequence.notes: Ballistic — explosive drive to the hip, control back.
Goblet squat → drive up into an overhead press in one motion.
Reverse lunge → drive the back knee up to a tall stand.

sets.name: 9-Minute AMRAP (Load Ladder: 30 → 40 → 50lb)

exercises.notes: **Ballistic row — explosive, not a slow controlled row.** Hinge at the hips, back flat, and drive the bell to the hip with power, then control it back. 8 per side. Brace the core, no torso rotation.

**Goblet squat → press in one motion (the source's 'goblet cluster').** Bell at the chest/goblet, squat to at least parallel, then drive up and use the leg momentum to press it overhead. Lock out tall, ribs down, then back into the next squat. Right-shoulder watch on the overhead — pack it down; if it won't lock out clean, this is the move to lighten first.
Step back to a reverse lunge → drive the back knee forward and up to a tall, balanced stand → repeat. Drive through the FRONT heel, stay tall. 8 per side.

sets.notes: **AMRAP — as many rounds of the three moves as possible in 9 minutes, NO rest between moves or rounds.** Single bell. **Load ladder over the three thirds:** 0:00-3:00 @ 30lb → 3:00-6:00 @ 40lb → 6:00-9:00 @ 50lb (swap the bell up at the 3- and 6-minute marks). Builds into the top weight instead of opening on your max. The thruster's overhead press is the limiter — if 50 won't press clean by the last third, hold 40 and chase rounds instead. Count total rounds + where you were when the bell got heavy.

tips: **It's a workout-set / AMRAP, not a flow** — power and breathing rate are the point, not smooth transitions.
**Load ladder 30 → 40 → 50lb** over the three 3-minute thirds — groove the pattern light, climb to the top bell. 50 is the Arrillaga ceiling; don't open there on a 9-min grinder.
**The thruster press is the limiter and the shoulder risk** — pack the shoulder down on the lockout; lighten the bell before the press gets ugly.
**Single bell throughout each third** — pick what's free, swap up at 3:00 and 6:00.
Good fit for a Tuesday strength/conditioning slot; NOT a Thursday move (too brutal the day before Friday legs).
